messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} how would
you feel {07 00 00}if lots of people
came to visit {04 03 00}?
And I'm talking about all at
once, not one at a time.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
So?{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}What do you think?{02 00 00 0f 10}
That'd be great!
Huh? What?

{07 14 00}Sometimes, I just like to
stand here and stare up
into the clouds.
And sometimes, I see other
things up there than just
clouds, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
If I had a{ff 00 00 07} slingshot{ff 00 00 00},{07 0b 00} I
wonder if I'd be able to
shoot them down.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

siin seista ja pilvedesse

Ja vahel näen ma seal
üleval muudki kui ainult

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} have you
signed up for health
insurance, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}I was thinking I'd get some
for myself, you know, just
in case something happens.
{07 16 00}But I heard there's been
some kind of insurance
scam going on lately!
{07 19 00}So be very suspicious of
anyone asking you to take
a survey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} kas sa oled
võtnud tervisekindlustuse,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Ma mõtlesin, et võtan ka
ka, tead küll, juhuks
kui midagi juhtub.
{07 16 00}Aga ma kuulsin, et viimasel
ajal on käinud mingi
kindlustuspettus!
{07 19 00}Nii et ole väga kahtlustav
kõigi suhtes, kes paluvad
sul küsitlust,{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I knew you had an eye for
interior design the moment
I saw you, {04 1f 00}.
{07 0d 00}The {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00} is
just going to love you
to pieces, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma teadsin, et sul on silm
sisekujunduseks hetkest,
kui sind nägin, {04 1f 00}.
{07 0d 00}{ff 00 00 02}Õnneliku Toa Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00}
hakkab sind lihtsalt
jumaldama, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Feng shui, silly{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} Think of

There's more to it than
that, though. It can even

{06 01 00 07 08 09}

{07 00 00}Feng shui, rumaluke{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} Mõtle
sellest kui tehnikast, mis
aitab tuba hubaseks teha.
Aga seal on rohkemat kui
see. See võib mõjutada

{06 01 00 07 08 09}

messages.en:
{07 14 00}For example, {01 00 00 0f 00}I've heard it's
good to put yellow items
against your west wall.
{07 0e 00}Yellow furniture{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} Hm{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
I wonder,{07 0b 00} do I have any
yellow furniture at home?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Näiteks, {01 00 00 0f 00}ma olen kuulnud, et
on hea panna kollaseid
asju lääneseina äärde.
{07 0e 00}Kollane mööbel{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} Hm{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Huvitav,{07 0b 00} kas mul on kodus
kollast mööblit?

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}I'm not entirely sure how it
all works, but{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 00 00}I hear that
something good will happen
if you put red furniture
along the eastern side of
your room, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Ma pole päris kindel, kuidas
see toimib, aga{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 00 00}kuulen, et
midagi head juhtub,
kui sa paned punase mööbli
oma toa idaküljele,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}If you want to try it, put
some green furniture in
your room's southern side.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui sa tahad proovida, pane
rohelist mööblit oma
toa lõunaküljele.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Are you serious?{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 00 00}I could
have sworn you were
already a member.
{07 16 00}Maybe I've got you confused
for someone else,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Kas sa tõsiselt?{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 00 00}Ma oleksin
vandunud, et sa oled
juba liige.
{07 16 00}Ehk ajasin ma sind kellegi
teisega segamini,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Really?{01 00 00 05 00} That's great.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}All
right, let me give you a
few tips, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}You know how you feel good{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0b 00}just being in a room that
has a real unity of color?
{07 00 00}Well, that's what the {ff 00 00 02}HRA{ff 00 00 00}
looks for, so collect items
that are the same color.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0d 00}I guarantee that you'll like
the results as much as the
{ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00} does!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Tõesti?{01 00 00 05 00} See on vahva.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}Hea
küll, las ma annan sulle
mõned vihjed, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Tead küll, kui hea tunne on{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0b 00}olla toas, kus on tõeline
värvide ühtsus?
{07 00 00}Noh, just seda {ff 00 00 02}ÕTA{ff 00 00 00}
otsib, nii et kogu asju,
mis on sama värvi.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0d 00}Ma garanteerin, et sulle
meeldivad tulemused sama
palju kui {ff 00 00 02}Akadeemiale{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Great!{01 00 00 05 00} I'm glad to hear
that.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}Let me give you the
inside scoop, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Rare furniture, the sort of
thing you get only at
special occasions,
{07 0d 00}gives you higher points
than plain old, everyday
furniture, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Suurepärane!{01 00 00 05 00} Hea meel seda
kuulda.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}Las ma annan sulle
sisemise info, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Haruldane mööbel, selline,
mida saab ainult
eriliste sündmuste ajal,
{07 0d 00}annab sulle rohkem punkte
kui tavaline igapäevane
mööbel, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Fantastic!{01 00 00 05 00} I'm glad.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}You'll
be extra glad to hear this,
then, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Don't just toss your stuff
on the floor.{01 00 00 05 00} Remember,
nobody likes a slob. 
It's important to keep your
room clean and to put your
stuff away properly.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Fantastiline!{01 00 00 05 00} Hea meel.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}Siis
rõõmustab sind veel see,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Ära lihtsalt viska oma asju
põrandale.{01 00 00 05 00} Pea meeles,
kellelegi ei meeldi lohakus. 
On tähtis hoida oma tuba
puhtana ja panna oma
asjad korralikult ära.

{07 0a 00}Ma ei võiks sinuga rohkem
nõus olla, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 01 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, if you want to
have lots of friends over,
just let me know, OK?
I'll try not to interrupt
your fun, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}. In
fact, I'll just stay inside.
{07 14 00}After all, you'll be busy

Ma üritan teie lõbu mitte

If you don't know, I'm not

{04 13 00} for you
